title: gpui Shader Effect Plan
description: A plan for one or more WGSL fragment-shader effects proposed for a gpui surface, shaped so it can be checked against this skill's 'earn the GPU pass' thesis and documented failure modes before any WGSL is written.

keptOutOfLinuxCI.description: True if the wgpu-dependent crate is isolated (companion crate, like pd-timeline-proto) so the rust-console Linux CI gate never compiles it.

name.description: Short identifier for the effect, e.g. 'living-harbor-water', 'sonar-sweep'.

needsPerPixelWork.description: True only if the effect is genuine per-pixel work (noise/fbm, SDF field, water, raymarch, full-res dither). False means it's shapes/quads/text that a gpui primitive or Vello should draw instead.

path.description: Companion window (own winit+wgpu, ADR-0086 path 3, ship-now) vs render-to-texture embed sampled back as a gpui image (ADR-0086 path 2, ambient/in-pane).

colorFromAccentUniform.description: True if color derives from the u.accent theme uniform + a cosine palette(), not a literal.

hardcodedHex.description: True if the WGSL contains a literal brand hex color instead of deriving from u.accent.

reducedMotionFreezesTime.description: True if reduced-motion freezes u.time to a hand-picked still, non-blank frame.

pausesWhenOffscreen.description: True if rendering stops/caps when the pane is offscreen, occluded, or the window is unfocused.

fbmOctaves.description: Number of fbm octaves used by the effect, if it uses fbm noise at all.

ditherTarget.description: What the Bayer dither threshold is applied to. 'per-rgb' produces colored speckle and is an anti-pattern.

pixelateFirst.description: True if UV is snapped to a coarse grid (pixelation) before the heavy noise/dither pass, reducing effective fragment count.
